race.description: Book In For Dinner, Jackson Security Newmarket Night, Nov 20 Mdn
race.comment: JOCK ROCK (14) stuck on well enough when finishing second here 3 weeks ago, and he should be suited by the rise to a mile. He benefits from a 2kg claim again and should go close to taking this out. SYMPHONY QUEEN (12) was a beaten favourite here last time out, and she will also step up to 1600m for the first time. She only needs a genuine tempo here to be an each-way threat. Follow your money. IRISH BLOOM (11) has been trying to win a race for some time and will start from a tricky gate here. Dropping back to 1600m will be the key, and she can run into the top 4 this time. Stick with her. SPINNER (10) is steadily improving with racing, and he will relish getting out to 1600m for the first time. David Pires picks up the ride, and he is capable of figuring in the finish here. SMITHY (8) will continue to improve as he gets up over a longer journey, and he is worth including in all combinations.
